name: Seishoku Ryoujoku ~Onna Kyoushi Kan'in~
source:
The main character is the principal of a private high school.
The story all begins when someone discovers and exploits the weaknesses of the beautiful teacher, Nada Ryoko.

Our main character becomes an unintentional witness to Ryoko kissing a student...and burning with jealousy, as he wanted Ryoko all for himself, the main character decided to uses this incident against Ryoko, extorting her so that she becomes his!

To completely shatter the teacher's ego or not... it all depends on YOUR choices.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033433.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是私立高中的校长。
故事始于有人发现并利用了美女教师灘良子的弱点。

主人公意外目睹良子亲吻学生……由于嫉妒，他想独占良子，于是决定利用这件事勒索她，让她成为自己的女人！

要不要彻底摧毁教师的自尊，全取决于你的选择。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033433.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
